universe.selection: same outcome-blind timestamp/identity panel; no outcome filtering

regime_router.efficiency_ratio: ER_N = abs(log(close_t/close_t-N)) / sum(abs(one-bar log returns)) over the N completed exact-contiguous M5 returns ending at t; require positive denominator
regime_router.causality: state and signal use only completed bars through t; any trade enters at t+1 open

trend_route.trigger: in trend_state, close_t must break the previous 12-bar high in positive trend direction or previous 12-bar low in negative trend direction
trend_route.failure: first completed post-entry close re-enters the frozen 12-bar breakout boundary; exit next open
trend_route.time_exit: exit next open after frozen maximum_hold_bars completed post-entry bars

range_route.center: median of log closes over previous 24 completed exact-contiguous bars excluding signal bar t
range_route.scale: 1.4826 * median absolute deviation of those 24 log closes around their frozen center; require >0
range_route.target: first completed post-entry close reaches/crosses frozen center in reversion direction; exit next open
range_route.failure: if completed close reaches >=2.0 times the initial signal deviation away from frozen center in adverse direction; exit next open
range_route.time_exit: exit next open after frozen maximum_hold_bars completed post-entry bars

overlap: at most one open event per symbol x architecture cell across either route; later signals ignored until exit
missing_data: all required links exactly 300 seconds; otherwise right-censor; no interpolation, resampling, gap bridging or same-bar execution

aggregation.event_level: retain route, symbol, UTC date and ISO week for every completed event
aggregation.symbol_day: mean gross bps of completed events per symbol per UTC date
aggregation.daily_family: equal-weight mean across available symbol-day statistics on each UTC date
aggregation.route_contribution: separately report equal-weight family statistics for TREND and RANGE route events

multiplicity.dependence_cluster: ISO week of daily family statistics
multiplicity.support_rule_predeclared: all six remain family members; support-ineligible cells receive p=1 and cannot pass

robust_region_gate.adjacency: one step in regime lookback or hold grid
